Sandbox_RadioBrasilEnableMarkers_Tooltip: If enabled, each broadcast with coordinates creates a marker on the world map.
Sandbox_RadioBrasilMarkerSize_Tooltip: Controls the size of map icons (0 = hidden; 10 = very large).
Sandbox_RadioBrasilBroadcastChance_Toolt: Chance, in percent, of a new broadcast each day between 08:00 and 11:00. 0% = never, 100% = every day.
Sandbox_RadioBrasilMinDaysBetweenBroadca: Minimum number of days between broadcasts. 0 = no minimum interval (broadcasts may happen every day).
Sandbox_RadioBrasilDisableCorpses_Toolti: If enabled, radio events will not create extra zombies, only loot.
Sandbox_RadioBrasilLootIntensity_Tooltip: Multiplier for items generated in each R?dio Brasil event. 1 = default, 2 = double items, up to 5 = five times more loot.
